text: For severe symptoms treatment may be begun by in- jection of 50 to 100 mg, repeated if necessary after 2 to 4 hours. Chlordiazepoxide hydrochloride has also been given for anaesthetic premedication in a dose of 50 to 100 mg intramuscularly one hour before surgery.
